name: @naaradh/engine-harness
comment: The shared engine-adapter contract suite. Test-only: nothing in any service's src/ may import it (pnpm lint:context). vitest is a devDependency pinned to the root version, NOT a peer — `auto-install-peers=true` (.npmrc) turns a peer into a real dependency, which dragged the whole vitest closure into the hooks/voice/workers production images and failed their trivy scan (shared/test/image-prod-deps.test.ts). Same exact version as the root runner, so pnpm links one physical copy and describe/expect share the runner's context.
